description: Agent Purchases: submit the quote an agent received for one paid call (amount, asset, network, quantity, unit price, what counts as delivered, when it was quoted and when it lapses) and the charge settled for it (amount, asset, network, quantity charged, quantity delivered, when it settled and its reference). The signed report compares the amount, asset, network and quantity field by field and names every mismatch: an amount that moved between quote and settlement in either direction with the difference and its share of the quote, a different asset or network, a different quantity and units charged but not delivered, then a quote whose unit price and quantity do not add up and a charge settled after the quote lapsed. Quoted terms against governing published terms are wever_terms-match-check, a live 402 challenge against advertised terms is wever_endpoint-honesty-check, charges against a fee schedule are wever_fee-reconciliation-check and an invoice against a payment is wever_invoice-payment-match. Verdict price_mismatch, quote_gaps, price_unverified or price_true. POST /api/price-truth-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-purchases-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-purchases/.

delivered_quantity.description: Units delivered under the quote’s own meaning of delivered.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

amount.description: The amount quoted before the call.

asset.description: Such as USDC or a token contract address.

delivered_means.description: What counts as delivered, as quoted.

expires.description: When the quote lapses, as a date and time.
